claims: No. 4 seed North Carolina defeated No. 5 seed Maryland 74-66.
The game was in the 2026 NCAA Women's Tournament second round.
North Carolina advanced to their second straight Sweet 16.
The final score was UNC 74, Maryland 66.
The venue was Carmichael Arena, Chapel Hill, NC.
North Carolina's Elina Aarnisalo scored 21 points.
North Carolina's Lanie Grant scored 20 points.
UNC pulled away in the fourth quarter after a 13-4 run led by Indya Nivar and a key 3-pointer by Nyla Brooks, according to the Atlantic Coast Conference and the Testudo Times.
North Carolina advances to play the winner of No. 1 UConn/No. 9 Syracuse.
The matchup marked a renewal of an old ACC rivalry.
The Tar Heels held home-court advantage.
